Michael Jackson appeared on the German television show Wetten, dass..? on November 4, 1995. During this broadcast, he performed "Dangerous" and, for the first time ever, "Earth Song".

snippet.description:
Remastered by me❤️🙏🏻

The "MTV Michael Jackson Millennium Award" is not a real award, but an incident at the August 29, 2002, MTV Video Music Awards.


Karen Faye (Michaels long time make up artist) had this to say about the fake award incident :

“Michael did not want to attend. Trudy Green and MTV told MJ he was going to receive this award so he would come, so they could get the ratings and advertising money. Was it Britney's fault...no. Did she know? I don't know. Did it devastate Michael? Absolutely.”
